summary.text: Mike Petersen is a Republican member of the Kansas Senate representing District 28 (Sedgwick County), and the Legislature's member page lists service in the Senate since 2005.
Mike Petersen is listed as chair of the Transportation Committee.

paragraphs.text: Mike Petersen is listed as a member of the Transportation Committee, the Utilities Committee, the Assessment and Taxation Committee and the Ways and Means Committee.
The Legislature lists Mike Petersen's occupation as Industrial Electrician.
The page names Shelby Petersen as Mike Petersen's spouse.
